pairs: From the depths, I have cried out to you,
Fiant aures tuæ intendentes in vocem deprecationis meæ.
Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplication.
If you, O Lord, were to heed iniquities,
For with you, there is forgiveness,
et propter legem tuam sustinui te, Domine.
and because of your law, I persevered with you,
Sustinuit anima mea in verbo ejus:
Lord. My soul has persevered in his word.
My soul has hoped in the Lord.
A custodia matutina usque ad noctem,
From the morning watch, even until night,
let Israel hope in the Lord.
For with the Lord there is mercy,
and with him there is bountiful redemption.
Et ipse redimet Israël ex omnibus iniquitatibus ejus.
And he will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
